requested_service.purpose: Fulfill a real inventory-check request or a narrowly matched Skubase support question.
process: Identify Skubase honestly without inventing a human identity
For requested inventory checks, offer the no-install browser SKU diagnostic at /tools/inventory-health-check
Explain that SKU entries stay in the browser, results depend on entered assumptions, and a reorder trigger is not an order quantity
Answer only the requested service need and offer a reply for interpretation help
Disclose the current Shopify App Store review status
Bind the exact body and template revision to the request and source knowledge
Preserve earlier workflow cohorts when the service template changes
Check suppression and dispatch authority immediately before sending
requested_service.output: One source-grounded service response and its durable dispatch record.
requested_service.success_signal: The requester obtains a useful inventory review or resolves the requested service question; verified first store connections and payments are stronger commercial outcomes. Anonymous calculator use alone is not an activation or qualified customer.
requested_service.cost_expectation: Deterministic templates, zero model tokens. Legitimate requested-service replies are exempt from the rolling 20-new-merchant ceiling; existing request, suppression and cost gates still apply. No postal address is collected.
